defs.def: only one 仅有一个的；单一的；单个的

ex.s: These biased perspectives cannot be blamed on one single cause.
ex.t: 这些有偏见的观点不能归因于任何一个单一原因。

ex.s: One fall，my wife Elli and I had a single goal:to photograph polar bears.
ex.t: 有一年秋天，我和妻子埃利只有一个目标：拍摄北极熊。

ex.s: A single sugary treat, selected by the child, was placed on a table.
ex.t: 桌上放着一样由孩子自己挑选的含糖零食。

ex.s: They shouldn’t be limited to a single method.
ex.t: 它们不应局限于单一方法。

ex.s: Sullivan had been thinking about the single present he’d received in 1954 when he was growing up in a small mining town.
ex.t: 沙利文一直想着1954年他在小采矿镇长大时收到的那件唯一的礼物。

ex.s: A few characters are used to create a single impression growing out of the theme.
ex.t: 用少数几个人物来创造一个源自主题的单一印象。

ex.s: I mention the single parent with four kids running the show and I talk about the dad coaching a team that his kids aren’t even on … At this point the unwilling parent speaks up,“Alright.
ex.t: 我提到那位带着四个孩子独撑局面的单亲家长，也谈到那位给根本不是自己孩子的球队当教练的父亲……这时，那位不情愿的家长开口了：“好吧。

ex.s: My little experiment to find joy in a single object worked for both of us.
ex.t: 我这从单一物品中寻找快乐的小实验对我们俩都奏效了。

ex.s: I really don’t think it’s worth the effort of spending so much time preparing for a single meal, and then another hour cleaning up the mess after its’ over.
ex.t: 我真的不认为花这么多时间准备一顿饭，然后在结束后再花一个小时清理烂摊子是值得的。

ex.s: He showed us that even a single desire, never given up on, can make for a remarkable life.
ex.t: 他向我们展示，哪怕只是一个永不放弃的愿望，也能成就非凡的人生。

ex.s: Yet the researchers suggest that single parents still may play a role in teaching the benefits of persistence, which is an avenue of future research.
ex.t: 然而，研究人员指出，单亲父母仍可能在教导坚持的好处方面发挥作用，这是未来研究的一个方向。

ex.s: So if we send out a robot with the single instruction of fetching coffee, it will have a strong desire to secure success by disabling its own off switch or even killing anyone who might interfere with its task.
ex.t: 所以，如果我们派出一个只接到“去取咖啡”这一指令的机器人，它会强烈渴望通过 disable 自己的关闭开关、甚至杀死任何可能干扰其任务的人来确保成功。

ex.s: "We even had a bride in her wedding dress come up to the board and take a few dollars." Most of the bills on the board were singles, but a few people left fives, tens and even twenties.
ex.t: “我们甚至有一位穿着婚纱的新娘走到板前拿了几美元。”板上的钞票大多是1美元，但有几个人留下了5美元、10美元甚至20美元。

ex.s: Experts say Paris is right: For a sudden heart failure, the single best chance for survival is having someone nearby step in and do CPR quickly.
ex.t: 专家们说巴黎的做法是对的：对于突发性心脏骤停，唯一的最佳生存机会是有人就近挺身而出并迅速实施心肺复苏术。

defs.def: not married or having a romantic relationship with sb 人

ex.s: Scholars still debate whether a single poet named Homer ever existed, as the poems were transmitted orally for many years before they were written down, and may have been worked on by many different poems.
ex.t: 学者们仍在争论是否真的存在一位名叫荷马的诗人，因为这些诗歌在被书写下来之前，曾口口相传了很多年，并且可能由许多不同的诗人加工过。

ex.s: Little did I realize that single moment would ruin everything.
ex.t: 如果你想要过上更可持续的生活方式，很有可能你身边的人并不会立刻加入你的行列。

defs.def: intended to be used by only one person 单人的
a single ticket, etc. can be used for travelling to a place but not back again 单程的

ex.s: Throughout our Junior year, my classmates and I have been worried about what colleges will see when they look at our whole life story reduced to a single 200-word essay.
ex.t: 整个高三那年，我和同学们一直担心，当大学招生官把我们整个生平浓缩成一篇200词的短文来审视时，他们会看到什么。

ex.s: •Register for a single week or multiple weeks.
ex.t: •注册一周或数周。

ex.s: How many hours of class will you have altogether if you register for a single week?
ex.t: 如果你注册一周，总共会有多少小时的课程？

ex.s: David had not missed a single practice, and although he always finished his run long after the other children, he did always finish.
ex.t: David没有错过一次训练，虽然他总是在其他孩子很久之后就完成了跑步，但他总是会完成。

ex.s: David had not missed a single practice, and although he always finished his run long after the other children, he did always finish.
ex.t: David没有错过一次训练，虽然他总是在其他孩子很久之后就完成了跑步，但他总是会完成。

ex.s: “My sales policy is not to collect a single penny.
ex.t: “我的销售政策是不收取一分钱。

ex.s: ■Write by hand or type on a single sheet of paper.
ex.t: ■手写或用打字机写在单张纸上。

ex.s: My most frightening but magical experience was now captured forever in a single image.
ex.t: 我最恐惧却又神奇的经历，此刻被定格在一张影像中，永远留存。

ex.s: Why don’t I help?” 2At first, his plan was to earn money to build a single well somewhere in Africa.
ex.t: 我为何不帮忙呢? 2A首先，他的计划是在非洲某处建造一口井赚钱。

ex.s: It was said to be the worst in 60 years, and not a single drop of rain fell for almost a whole year.
ex.t: 据说这是60年来最严重的一次，几乎整整一年没有下一滴雨。

defs.def: a ticket that allows you to travel to a place but not back again 单程票
a piece of recorded music, usually popular music, that consists of one song; a CD that a single is recorded on 单曲（常指流行音乐）；单曲激光唱片
a room in a hotel, etc. for one person （旅馆等的）单人房间
a bill/note that is worth one dollar 一元纸币
people who are not married and do not have a romantic relationship with sb else 单身者；无伴侣者
a game when only one player plays against one other; a series of two or more of these games 尤指网球
a hit from which a player scores one run (= point) 板球
a hit that only allows the player to run to first base 棒球

chunks.cn: 单一的周 / 单一的一餐 / 单一的目标 / 单一的导致 / 单一的愿望 / 单一的物体 / 单一的方法 / 单一的父母 / 单一的印象
